SANDEEP KUMAR M

BUSINESS ANALYST (Capital Market & Investment Banking)

7309891812

Ksandeep.070694@gmail.co m

JOB OBJECTIVE Leveraging over 10+ years of experience in Investment Banking, Operations, Business Analysis, and Data Management within the Banking and Financial Services sector. Proven expertise across settlements, reconciliation, payments, corporate actions, and reference data, with hands-on skills in tools like SQL, JIRA, Excel, and Power BI to drive automation, efficiency, and compliance.

PROFILE SUMMARY

Business Analyst with experience in Capital Markets and Investment Banking, specializing in Operations, Reference Data, Corporate Actions, Trade Lifecycle, Trade Settlements, Equities, and Fixed Income. Currently working at Apptad Technologies, delivering business analysis and process optimization initiatives.

Driving automation of Corporate Actions platforms to reduce manual effort, improve operational efficiency, enhance reconciliation accuracy, and support cost optimization. Experienced in resolving settlement discrepancies, cash and position breaks, and production issues through data-driven analysis.

Skilled in business analysis, requirement gathering, stakeholder management, process modelling, SQL-based data analysis, impact analysis, and Agile delivery, with hands-on experience using SQL, Power BI, JIRA, Confluence, and Advanced Excel.

CORE COMPETENCIES  Business Analysis  Capital Market/Investment

Proven ability to bridge business and technology teams, deliver scalable solutions, improve data quality, optimize business processes, and support operational excellence across Capital Markets applications.

Banking/Finance

WORK EXPERIENCE

Reference Data  Reconciliation  Trade Lifecycle/Settlement  Asset Class (Equity/Fixed Income/Derivatives)

Agile/ Scrum Methodology  Risk Management  Business Process Optimization  Data Visualization  SLA and KPI Management  Stakeholder Management  Asset Management IT SKILLS  SQL | Power BI | JIRA | Microsoft Excel | ISO SWIFT Messaging

Business Analyst | Apptad Technology, Hyderabad Sep’25-Present Process: Business Analyst /Investment Banking & Finance Key Result Areas:  Acted as a Functional Business Analyst supporting Capital Markets and Investment Banking applications, driving digital transformation across Front, Middle, and Back Office functions.  Gathered, analyzed, and documented business requirements for Equities, Fixed Income, Reference Data, and Security Master processes through collaboration with business users and technology teams.

Utilized SQL to perform data analysis, troubleshoot production issues, validate large datasets, support operational reporting, and generate business insights.

Performed data reconciliation and analytical validation between upstream and downstream systems, ensuring data integrity, pricing accuracy, and effective exception management.

Conducted impact analysis and trend analysis to opportunities and support data-driven business decisions.

identify  process  improvement

Investigated production incidents through Root Cause Analysis and partnered with development teams to resolve application and data-related issues.

SOFT SKILLS  Problem-solving  Leadership  Analysis  Communication

Managed Reference Data and Static Data while supporting Security Pricing, Market Data, and enterprise data quality controls.

Prepared BRDs, FRDs, Functional Specifications, User Stories, process flows, and functional documentation to translate business requirements into technology solutions.

Coordinated Functional Testing, SIT, Regression Testing, and UAT, including test case preparation, defect tracking, data validation, and business sign-off.

ACHIEVEMENTS  Successfully established new client

relationships and delivered exceptional services

Delivered multiple projects which helped to provide more accuracy and FT savings

Efficiently migrated processes, meeting SLAs and ensuring seamless transitions

Recognized by the quality team as a standout contributor to implementing a process improvement idea at Statestreet.  Actively participated in multiple

Collaborated with Front Office, Operations, Business Users, QA, and Development teams to deliver process improvements and production support enhancements.

Supported file-based processing (CSV/Flat Files) and utilized SQL, JIRA, Confluence, SharePoint, and Advanced Excel for analysis, reporting, backlog management, and release coordination.

Participated in Agile Scrum ceremonies, effectively managing multiple priorities while ensuring timely delivery of projects and production support.

PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE

Business Analyst/Project Manager | Citi Corp, Gurugram Jan’22-Sep’25 Process: Business Analyst /Investment Banking & Finance Key Result Areas:  Business Analyst with strong Capital Markets expertise across Investment Banking,

Equities, Fixed Income, Asset Management, and Corporate Actions.

 Worked in Asset Servicing (Custodian Bank), managing end-to-end payment lifecycle and

SWIFT communications (MT564/566/599) with global agent banks.

projects aimed at enhancing process efficiency

 Led Reference Data initiatives in Global Change Management, driving automation under

CoaX to standardize Corporate Actions processing.

CERTIFICATIONS  Six Sigma (Green Belt)  Professional Certificate in Data Science and Business Analytics

EDUCATION  MBA in Finance from Ashoka Institute of Technology and Management, Uttar Pradesh Technical University, Varanasi | 2015

B.Com. in Business/ Commerce General from Mohammad Hasan PG College, Purvanchal University, Jaunpur | 2012

PERSONAL DETAILS  Date of Birth: 07th June 1994  Marital Status: Married  Address: Hyderabad - 500090

 Gathered and documented business requirements (BRD, FRS, User Stories) through

stakeholder collaboration, ensuring alignment with Agile practices.

 Acted as a key liaison between Business, IT, QA, and Delivery teams, ensuring traceability

from requirements to implementation.

 Managed projects using Agile methodologies, handling JIRA backlog, UAT coordination,

defect tracking, and stakeholder communication.

Performed impact analysis, process mapping, and solution design to improve reconciliation, operational efficiency, and system performance.

Utilized SQL for data analysis, validation, reconciliation, and production issue investigation across enterprise applications.

Analyzed large datasets, prepared ad-hoc reports, and identified data quality issues to support business decisions and process improvements.

Team Leader | State Street HCL Services, Pune Jun’20-Jan’22 Senior Associate | State Street Corporation Services, Hyderabad Dec’17-Jun’20 Process: Business Analyst (Asset Servicing) Key Result Areas:  Conducted Data Quality Analysis & Management for Asset Servicing across Equities, Fixed

Income, and Derivatives.

Gathered requirements, performed gap analysis, and documented BRDs, FSDs, and user stories for automation initiatives.

Led Process Migration and Client Onboarding by coordinating with stakeholders and ensuring smooth transitions.

Managed data vendors (Bloomberg, DTC, IDC, Euroclear, TKS, EMC) and Custody feeds for Swift ISO 15022 & 2022.

Collaborated with Pricing and Client Ops teams to validate business rules and support corporate action processing.

Reconciled events between accounting and custody platforms, identifying gaps and recommending improvements.

Defined acceptance criteria, supported UAT, and ensured traceability of requirements for system enhancements.

Addressed client queries, provided tailored solutions, and ensured timely issue resolution.  Reviewed and updated SOPs, supporting change management and compliance initiatives.  Acted as a liaison between business stakeholders, operations, and IT for end-to-end delivery of change projects.

Corporate Action Analyst (B1) | Wipro BPS, Pune Jul’17-Nov’17 Process: Operations – Asset Servicing Corporate Actions Key Result Areas:  Managed pre- and post-settlement processes within the Equity Asset Servicing team,

ensuring comprehensive oversight of receivables for all claims.

Verified trades, encompassing Stock-Lending and Cash Trade, with respect to Corporate Action event dates like Ex-Date, Record Date, and Pay Date, to ascertain dividend entitlement.

Process: Settlement Date Adjustment Key Result Areas:  Worked collaboratively with PB Client (Prime Brokerage) to update client holdings during

designated days of Mandatory Corporate Action.

Supervised operations spanning three regions: The United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore.

Financial Analyst | Eclerx Services Ltd., Pune Jan’16-Jun’17 Process: Corporate Action ‘Payments and reconciliation’ Key Result Areas:  Operated within the asset servicing department of a client (custodian bank), managing pre-

payment, payment, and post-payment activities.

Initiated communication with Agent Banks in various countries to facilitate payment notification and confirmation through SWIFT (MT564, MT566, and MT599).
